checks.name: The SHA-256 written beside the image matches the image
The disk image mounts read-only and holds Barkdown.app beside an Applications link
The application copied out of the image carries the pinned runtime; the image is detached before it runs
The packaged rehearsal (first boot, note, restart) passes against the copy installed from the image
Removing the application leaves the user data where it was
The application reinstalled from the image opens the same library and the note reads the same
A replacement bundle without its runtime does not start the library and leaves the profile data untouched

observed.error: This copy of Barkdown is missing the runtime it should carry. Reinstall Barkdown; your notes and profiles are kept.

checks.name: The previous bundle put back opens the same library and the note reads the same (failed-upgrade rollback)

limits: One Mac. The image is ad hoc signed and not notarized: on another Mac Gatekeeper refuses it until the signature exists. Dragging is simulated by a copy.
